features: Dedicated HH:MM:SS local-time card separated from line names and status notices
Three configurable support shortcuts with independent labels, message destinations and visibility
Information tabs for project overview, contact, MIT license and safe deployment
Balanced number/QWERTY rows and a separate complete symbol keyboard
fixes: Keep failure-choice cards equal in size, including incomplete rows, with a separate selection toolbar
Keep touch targets stationary while showing press, release and contact acknowledgement
Use available Update-panel space for version cards and correctly sized action rows
Keep section headings beside their explanations when paginating information
Preserve existing incident assignment and automatic notifications when customizing manual support calls
Retain the original destination of already queued support messages after Settings edits
release.release_summary: Refined kiosk interaction with a dedicated seconds clock, balanced touch keyboard, consistent failure choices, configurable support shortcuts and clearer information and update pages.
security: Support configuration validates labels, destinations, visibility and the exact three-slot structure
Administrator authorization, connector capability checks and signed-update verification remain enforced
Release packages contain neutral disabled connectors and no deployment credentials or private signing keys
